visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens inside a car with a panoramic glass roof on a bright, sunny day. A man in his 30s is driving, wearing white-framed sunglasses and a black tank top, looking straight ahead or into the camera. In the back seat, a woman is seen holding an open white umbrella to shield herself and a small child from the intense sunlight pouring through the roof. The man occasionally sighs and adjusts his glasses. (2) The visual context shifts; it is now raining heavily outside, with visible water droplets and streaks on the glass roof. The man is now holding a large black umbrella over his head while sitting in the driver's seat. He maintains a deadpan, stoic expression, occasionally looking sideways while the umbrella handle rests on his shoulder. The lighting is cooler and more overcast compared to the first phase.
